title: Level Set Method for Positron Emission Tomography
title_en: Level Set Method for Positron Emission Tomography
title_zh: 正电子发射断层扫描的水平集方法
abstract_en: In positron emission tomography (PET), a radioactive compound is injected into the body to promote a tissue-dependent emission rate. Expectation maximization (EM) reconstruction algorithms are iterative techniques which estimate the concentration coefficients that provide the best fitted solution, for example, a maximum likelihood estimate. In this paper, we combine the EM algorithm with a level set approach. The level set method is used to capture the coarse scale information and the discontinuities of the concentration coefficients. An intrinsic advantage of the level set formulation is that anatomical information can be efficiently incorporated and used in an easy and natural way. We utilize a multiple level set formulation to represent the geometry of the objects in the scene. The proposed algorithm can be applied to any PET configuration, without major modifications.

title: The Union of Knowing and Doing and Free Will
title_en: The Union of Knowing and Doing and Free Will
title_zh: 知行与自由意志的结合
venue: Huadong Shifan Daxue xuebao. Ziran kexue ban
abstract_en: Negatively,free will indicates a non-dependent state,and positively it is a state of autonomous selection and links up with human moral obligations.Kant assumes the existence of free will,but he fails to put such an abstract postulation of the subject's freedom into effect in man.Crucially,he fails to truly internalize the moral will and unite it with life's intelligent driving force.As to Wang Yangming,moral reason is identical with human inherent moral sentiments.Both the intelligent self-decision and the impetus of egoist will make conflicts between human body and mind and between knowing and doing coordinated and integrated.
abstract_zh: 消极地,自由意志表明一种不依赖的状态,积极地,它是一种自主选择的状态,与人的道德义务相联系。康德假定了自由意志的存在,但他并没有把这样一个抽象的主体自由假设落实到人身上。最关键的是,他未能将道德意志真正内化并与生命的智能驱动力相统一。对于王阳明来说,道德理性与人固有的道德情感是一致的。利己主义的推动力会使人的身心、知行之间的冲突协调统一。

title: Two-Dimensional Frequency Estimation in Correlative Noise Based on Genetic Algorithm
title_en: Two-Dimensional Frequency Estimation in Correlative Noise Based on Genetic Algorithm
title_zh: 基于遗传算法的相关噪声二维频率估计
venue: World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract_en: The problem of two-dimensional (2D) harmonics retrieval in the presence of correlative zero-mean multiplicative and additive noise was presented. We propose a genetic algorithm (GA)-based approach to this problem. Firstly, we defined a special 2D slice of sixth-order time-average moment spectrum, which has peaks value at the harmonics frequencies. Second, we converted the problem of harmonics retrieval into extremum problem of binary function. Finally, the GA was employed to estimate the frequencies of 2D harmonics. The effectiveness of our algorithms is demonstrated through some simulations
abstract_zh: 提出了在存在相关零均值乘性和加性噪声的情况下二维（2D）谐波检索问题。我们提出了一种基于遗传算法（GA）的方法来解决这个问题。首先，我们定义了六阶时间平均矩谱的特殊二维切片，其在谐波频率处具有峰值。其次，我们将谐波检索问题转化为二元函数的极值问题。最后，利用遗传算法来估计二维谐波的频率。通过一些模拟证明了我们算法的有效性

title: The Research Report on Teaching Experiment for College English Discourse Reading
title_en: The Research Report on Teaching Experiment for College English Discourse Reading
title_zh: 大学英语语篇阅读教学实验研究报告
abstract_en: Traditional reading teaching pays more attention to the analysis and understanding of micro units such as vocabularies, sentences, and grammar. Thus it fails to analyze and understand passages at the high level of discourse and negatively influence the cultivatation and increase of learners' reading ability. Discourse reading teaching, aimed at discourse, will direct learners to grasp the connection of vocabularies, of sentences and of paragraphs and then to deeply understand structures and meanings of passages from strategically advantageous position.
abstract_zh: 传统阅读教学更注重对词汇、句子、语法等微观单元的分析和理解。从而无法在高水平的语篇中分析和理解文章，对学习者阅读能力的培养和提高产生负面影响。语篇阅读教学以语篇为目标，指导学习者掌握词汇、句子、段落的联系，进而从战略高度深入理解段落的结构和意义。

title_zh: 高等学校要大力弘扬和培育民族精神
venue: Journal of Hefei University of Technology
abstract_en: In the 16th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, Comrade JiangZe-min emphasized that carrying forward and cultivating the national spirit must be regarded as a very important task of the culture construction and be brought into the whole process of the national education. As the important base of talent cultivation, institution of higher learning should carry forward and cultivate the national spirit strongly. abstract_zh: 江泽民同志在党的十六大上强调，必须把弘扬和培育民族精神作为文化建设的一项十分重要的任务，纳入国民教育的全过程。高等学校作为人才培养的重要基地，理应大力弘扬和培育民族精神。本文简要阐述了民族精神的基本内涵，阐释了弘扬和培育民族精神对于青年大学生的重要意义，并提出了相应的对策建议。

title_zh: 美国社区学院的情况对我国高等职业教育发展的启示
abstract_en: The vocational education development of American community college has three inspirations for China's higher vocational education. The first one is that the persons' acceptation and approval of higher vocational education need a process, so those who are engaged in higher vocational education should not lose confidence. The second one is that community and colleges should coordinate and train a kind of applied talented persons who adapt themselves to the needs of local economic and social development. The third one is that the trend of higher vocational education development is inevitable to strengthen the fusion of vocational technological education and academic education.
abstract_zh: 美国社区学院职业教育的发展对我国高等职业教育有三点启示。一是人们对高职教育的接受和认可需要一个过程，从事高职教育的人不要失去信心。二是社区和学校要统筹协调，培养适应地方经济社会发展需要的应用型人才。三是强化职业技术教育与学历教育融合是高等职业教育发展的必然趋势。

title_zh: 一种新的两级Schwarz方法
venue: IEEE International Conference on High Performance Computing, Data, and Analytics
abstract_en: In this paper, it is demonstrated that, for traditional two-level Schwarz methods, coarse grid correction alone is not sufficient. In addition, a new two-level overlapping method coupling coarse grid correction with interface precondition is developed. Numerical experiments suggest that this method is much better than traditional two-level Schwarz methods.
abstract_zh: 本文证明，对于传统的两级 Schwarz 方法，仅进行粗网格校正是不够的。此外，还开发了一种新的将粗网格校正与界面前提条件耦合的两级重叠方法。数值实验表明该方法比传统的两级Schwarz方法要好得多。
